senses.gloss: ch. sameto thrust, push, knock down.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 35:20">Targ. O. Num. XXXV, 20</cite> <he>דְּחָהִי</he> he knocked him down (h. text <he>הדף</he>; Y. <cite ref="D00408"><he>דַּחְיֵיה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 118:13">Targ. Ps. CXVIII, 13</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Zevachim 12b:4">Zeb. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>הוא ד׳ נפשיה בידים</he> he debarred himself from offering (on account of his apostasy).
<cite ref="Pesachim 69b:11">Pes. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>אימא לִידְחֵי</he> I might think they take precedence of the Sabbath.
<cite ref="Berakhot 23a:2">Ber. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>גברא דְחוּיָא הוא</he> the person was for the time in an unfit condition to pray (and his prayer does not count at all).
<cite ref="Pesachim 57a:3">Pes. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>דַּחוּיֵי קא מַדְחֵי לן</he> he sends us off (with a vain promise).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 36:13">Targ. Ps. XXXVI, 13</cite> <he>אִידָּחֲיַין</he> Ms. (ed. <he>יִדְחֲיַן</he>); a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 9:10">Targ. Y. Num. IX, 10</cite>.—
<cite ref="Zevachim 12b:4">Zeb. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>ממילא אי׳</he> he was debarred from offering through no fault of his.
<cite ref="Zevachim 12b:4">Ib.</cite> <he>גברא אי׳</he> the person was unfit; a. fr.
